topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I never took Tom to be one for stories, what with his hands always busy with the plow or the hive. But here it is, this stack of papers he keeps hidden under his cot. I stumbled upon it while sorting out old coats. His writing speaks of our days, of our life here in the village, painted in words so vivid it’s like I’m living it all over again, but through someone else’s eyes. I’m not sure what to make of it. It’s a strange feeling, seeing our life turned into a tale, when all I ever thought of it was the toil and the seed and the soil. What if others read it, and see us in a way we don’t even recognize? What does he see in these pages that I don’t?
